title: Frank Leone Post Office Act
official_summary:
Frank Leone Post Office Act

Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 332 Ramapo Valley Road in Oakland, New Jersey, as the "Frank Leone Post Office."

summary.headline: Names a post office building in Oakland, New Jersey, after Frank Leone.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 332 Ramapo Valley Road in Oakland, New Jersey, as the "Frank Leone Post Office." It is a naming measure only. It does not change how the post office operates, its services, or its staff.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 21, 2018, and the new name applies from that date.
